The '''Black Sun foot soldier blaster''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] wielded by the [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that featured two barrels.

==History==
[[File:Black_Sun_foot_soldier_blaster.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] using their blasters]]
During the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]], the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]] and his [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|soldiers]] used double blaster pistols to kill [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] civilians and [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] guards. At the [[Sundari dock warehouse/Legends|Sundari dock warehouse]], several [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] soldiers wielded this type of blaster, while accompanying [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BlackHoleGun.png|thumb|right|100px|S.T.A.R. using the original guns in ''The Black Hole'']]
The gun was based upon a design used by robot guards in the [[Wikipedia:The Black Hole|''The Black Hole'']], a [[1979]] movie from [[The Walt Disney Company]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/eminence-episode-guide|text="Eminence" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
